## Requirement

<a id="FullRefundAhead"></a>

### A day ahead, a full refund

`FullRefundAhead` · `src/consumer.ts:25` · status: **held**

Whatever the product decides about late fees, a reservation cancelled at least the notice ahead is refunded in full. The legal team answers for it; it constrains the refund the product computes, played on its examples at every build.

<details><summary>The rule, in the code</summary>

```typescript
({ notice }) => (r, leadTime, refund) => leadTime < notice || refund === r.price
```

</details>

<details><summary>The examples, in the code</summary>

```typescript
[
    [{ charger: ChargerType.normal, price: chf(20) }, h(24)],
    [{ charger: ChargerType.fast, price: chf(35) }, h(30)],
    [{ charger: ChargerType.normal, price: chf(20) }, h(1)],
  ]
```

</details>
